title: Agentops project binding
description: Structural shape of project.toml, expressed as JSON Schema (TOML maps 1:1 onto these JSON types). Documentation and optional runtime-validation reference; not itself the file format.

project_id.description: Minted once via uuid4 at project creation. Immutable: no tool ever regenerates this value.

home_repo.description: Must equal the repo_id of exactly one entry in members. Hosts the project's backlog (sprintctl) and render sources (.project/sources/).

repo_id.description: Matches the repo's sprintctl repo_id and *.dispatch.json repo_id.

backlog.description: Include this repo's sprintctl backlog in --project union views.

render.description: Instruction distribution level. full: all project source fragments. baseline: fragments tagged render_levels including baseline. none: no generated file, no pointer line — repo is untouched by render.

relationship.description: Descriptive member relationship; it does not grant authority. Omitted values preserve the implementation default.

access.description: Materialization boundary. reference members use detached, filesystem-read-only worktrees and receive no render writes; omitted values preserve writable-member behavior.

repository.description: Optional credential-free canonical HTTPS Git URL. Required when creating a portable project-release descriptor.

default_ref.description: Optional canonical default branch ref. Required when creating a portable project-release descriptor.

path_notes.description: Optional free-text agent guidance specific to this member's binding. Not rendered; read directly from project.toml by agents resolving project scope.

documents.description: Declarative member document contract. Paths are normalized relative paths within the member repository. AGENTS.md is authored and required for every member; generated project guidance is renderer-managed and required for full/baseline members, forbidden for render:none members.
